hints.title: Split around each position
hints.body: The product except position `i` is the product of everything to its left times the product of everything to its right.

hints.title: Prefix pass
hints.body: Store the product of all earlier values in the output slot for each position.

hints.title: Suffix pass
hints.body: Walk backward with a running suffix product and multiply it into each slot.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
result = array of n ones
prefix = 1
for i from 0 to n-1:
    result[i] = prefix
    prefix *= nums[i]
suffix = 1
for i from n-1 down to 0:
    result[i] *= suffix
    suffix *= nums[i]
return result
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
